_doc: Canonical model-family map. Used by RemoteSemKNNRouter to derive a user_config fingerprint to send to the SemKNN backend; the backend ships an identical copy and canonicalizes its own profiles the same way. Patterns are lowercased substrings; first family whose any-pattern matches the lowercased model string wins. Unknown models pass through unchanged. Edit liberally to map a private fine-tune to the closest public family — fine-tune of llama-3.2-70b would typically be mapped to 'llama-3' for routing purposes. NOTE: 'rough_params' below is a coarse, FAMILY-level hint only and is NOT the conditioning signal for matching — the real per-channel size lives in user_config.channel_specs[].params_b, parsed per-instance from the concrete model id (':30b', '8x7b', ...) by parse_params_b(). Size materially affects q-matrix calibration, so the backend should match on channel_specs (family + params_b [+ quant]), not on family alone. The judge model is NOT part of the fingerprint (channels only).
